These small KEEL-STYLED-ASSET v1 fixtures were generated by the engine's styled-asset tests. They contain one synthetic skinned triangle with one animation clip. Original, pixel and dither preserve that clip; voxel contains a static cube recipe and retains its source native package.

They are data-only binary envelopes. The test invokes the trusted engine importer and the actual desktop worker/player; it never evaluates uploaded JavaScript. Regenerate using keel-engine/packages/import styled-asset tests when the versioned format changes.
